heading: Your
lede: Write down when you turned the lights off and when you got up. You can do it by hand at any time, so the app does not need to be on when you wake up.
morningOfHint: A night belongs to the day you wake up. If you are going to bed tonight, choose tomorrow.
timesHint: Fill in one or both. You can add the other one later.
invalid: Please check the day and the times. A night lasts at most 16 hours.
batteryGuessed: Based on your target, because the time you fell asleep is missing.
batteryEmpty: Log when you got up today to see an estimate.
batteryMissing: The last wake-up you logged is more than a day ago, so there is nothing reliable to show. Log last night and it comes back.
batteryNote: A simplified model of sleep pressure, which builds up while you are awake and drains while you sleep. It is not a measurement of your body.
noNights: Nothing logged yet. Log your first night by hand, or tap a button when you go to bed.
onlyLightsOff: Lights off {time}, waiting for the wake-up time
targetHint: Adults usually do best with about 7 to 9 hours. This is only the line your last night is compared with, and the battery does not use it unless a time is missing.
foot: No points, no reminders and no streaks. A day without a night is simply empty.
widgetEmpty: Log last night to see your battery.
